name: Publishable Type identity requires stable hash support

input.fixture_ref: Compare publishable nominal Type hashes across separate runtime allocations and source paths with the same package identity.

applicability.reason: Requires Type hash and package identity reflection. The five C075 queries now exist and TYPES-V917 observes them, but `A.type.hash()` and `A.type.package()` both answer MessageNotFound, so a Type's stable hash and owning package remain unreported.

expect.status: Type identity depends on stable package and normalized Type identity facts, never display names or machine-local allocation data.
